name: BUMK 515 classic (teal, Lato, single column)

provenance.source: BUMK-515-TEMPLATE Brightspace export, exported 2026-10-01, org unit 102529
provenance.note: Page CSS and skeleton are lifted from the old course pages. Fragment styles are the inline styles the old course used most often in assignment and discussion description fields.

styles.wrapper: max-width: 48rem; margin: 0 auto; font-family: 'Lato','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif; color: #202122; line-height: 1.65; font-size: 19px;
styles.h6: color: #134f5c; margin: 1rem 0 .5rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; font-style: italic;
styles.callout: border-left: 4px solid #134f5c; background: #f5fafa; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 4px; margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; padding: .5rem; vertical-align: top; text-align: left;

open_design_note: A template is a directory with this manifest. The packager selects one by id in build settings. Future templates (Page Kit kits, Pagewrights' Guild designs, design-kit pages) plug in by supplying the same two surfaces.
